name: haveibeensquatted
description: Analyze domains, hunt lookalikes and search certificate transparency; triage your organization's detections and alerts, and manage its domains, rules and takedowns.

interface.longDescription: Analyze any domain live, scan for typosquats and unregistered lookalikes, and search certificate transparency logs. With a monitoring plan, query and triage your organization's detections and alerts, manage its monitored domains and detection rules, and open takedown cases. Requires a Have I Been Squatted account; every call is scoped to the organization you choose when you sign in and to your role in it, and changes need an organization admin.
defaultPrompt: Triage this week's lookalike detections for my organization and flag the ones that look malicious
Search certificate transparency for new certificates imitating my company's domain in the last 30 days
Analyze this suspicious domain and tell me whether it looks like phishing infrastructure
